name: Frame-Guard
description: Frame-Guard Android overlay with live player collision geometry, an observed player-box trail, optimized rectangle-based hitbox culling, input telemetry, independently configurable tick horizon and a configurable forward trajectory estimate. Input-window simulation now advances one modeled update per tick and separates forecast horizon from visual hitbox margin; prediction remains approximate because game triggers and collision resolution are not replayed.

show-hitboxes.name: Show hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Draw collision geometry near the active play area to reduce rendering overhead on long levels.

show-trajectory.name: Show trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Show the player's observed collision-box trail from actual game updates plus an eight-step forward trajectory estimate. The observed trail tracks the real player; the future projection cannot perfectly reproduce all triggers, portals or collision resolution.

show-player-bounds.name: Show player bounds
show-player-bounds.description: Show the current player collision boxes for player 1 and player 2.

show-fps.name: Show FPS counter
show-fps.description: Show a lightweight FPS estimate based on PlayLayer update delta time.

frameguard-enabled.name: Enable FrameGuard telemetry
frameguard-enabled.description: Record input press/release edges with monotonic timestamps and current level-update frame. Does not alter gameplay.

show-frameguard-hud.name: Show FrameGuard HUD
show-frameguard-hud.description: Display frame counter, input count, and last input timing on screen.

show-info-text.name: Show informational text
show-info-text.description: Show or hide informational HUD text.

overlay-opacity.name: Overlay opacity
overlay-opacity.description: Opacity of hitboxes and trajectory, from transparent to fully visible.

safe-margin-ticks.name: Safe margin ticks
safe-margin-ticks.description: Extra visual padding around projected hitboxes. This only changes how cautiously the trajectory overlay marks nearby hazards; it does not change the forecast duration.

prediction-horizon-ticks.name: Prediction horizon ticks
prediction-horizon-ticks.description: Number of simulated game-update steps used by the tick timing estimate and hazard warning. Each tick represents one modeled update; future physics remain approximate.

toggle-menu.name: Toggle Frame-Guard menu
toggle-menu.description: Toggle the floating Frame-Guard menu with the F key.

show-safe-window.name: Show input timing estimate
show-safe-window.description: Estimate candidate press/release timing for continuous-input modes. It is an approximate preview only and never delays or changes inputs.
